text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Ines 
Fuujin, we bumped into Mr. C.B. in the 
shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I saw your mock race the other day! I was 
so shocked by that spurt you made from out 
of nowhere!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Really? Hehe. I'm glad if you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to run an awe-inspiring race too. 
Like, uhm... not just a tactical 
front-runner, but purely running 
full-throttle the entire time and winning!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin chats with Mr. C.B. with 
sparkling eyes. It's kind of, well—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Of course I do! C.B.-san is a senior 
I respect, so I have to show her proper 
reverence!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it okay for us to be standing 
around chatting like this? Didn't you have 
something to do...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I came out to do some shopping. I 
thought it'd be nice to cook a proper meal 
for myself for once, and pick out some 
quality ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't usually go this far, so I was 
wandering around not knowing where to find 
what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's already evening—are you going to be 
okay? The shops that close early will be 
shutting down soon, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, I see. That's quite a pickle then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'd love to help if it's alright! As 
your junior, leave the backup to me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Man, who would've thought the butcher's 
shop sold breadcrumbs? I even managed to 
buy some of their famous croquettes, 
too..."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, look. It says these flowers were 
planted by local elementary school kids. 
They're pretty.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Please wait a moment, C.B.! They're still 
in the middle of frying the croquettes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
C-CB-san is pretty... free-spirited, or 
should I say...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, CB-san is gone again... CB-saaan?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look, the toy store over there was selling 
a pair of roller skates older than 
anything I've ever seen before.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You bought it?! You can't do that, you 
shouldn't waste money like that. We still 
have so many groceries to buy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As she followed the free-spirited Mr. 
C.B. around, Ines Fujin's tense expression 
gradually softened back to her usual 
self—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Look, Ines. Roasted sweet potatoes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No you don't! You just had a croquette, 
didn't you? You won't have room for 
dinner!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?! I-I-I'm so sorry! Talking back 
to an upperclassman like that, I just...!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft. Ahaha! Ines, you're hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it at all. You don't 
need any of that "I have to be super 
formal because you're an upperclassman" 
nonsense with me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Racing is the same. It's precisely by 
breaking from common sense that you can 
seize something extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Ines Fujin instinctively slipped into her 
big sister routine even toward her 
senior."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the contrary, it seemed to be a 
positive trait that would broaden her 
potential."
choice_data_list: I'm going to be the ultimate "big sister"!

Let's just do whatever we want with Mr. 
C.B. today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Mr. C.B. said, I told Ines Fujin 
that she should give it everything she's 
got in her own usual style!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! No, surely that's taking it too 
far...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me. Though I'm warning you, 
I'm quite a handful as a little sister, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mister, one roasted sweet potato, please!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, see! I told you you wouldn't have room 
for dinner!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, don't just stand there 
watching, help me out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin remained her usual natural 
self, even against her senior. It seems to 
have been a great experience for her!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well then, maybe I'll just grab takeout 
for dinner. Since I got to see you all 
today, I can put off cooking for myself 
until tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
W-Would that mean breaking common 
sense...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows? But I'm sure it'll be 
fun—sticking to what you want to do in the 
moment without compromising, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Never compromising on what I want to do...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...All right, C.B.-san! Let's have ramen 
for dinner! And then—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Race you to the shop!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So that's what you 'want to do.' Hehe, 
sounds great, Ines. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two dash through the evening glow. 
Watching their backs, so earnest about 
running, made me feel as if they were 
somehow alike.
